    DATE_TRUNC(orders.created_at, MONTH) AS `orders___created_at`,

  FROM orders AS orders
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC(orders.created_at, MONTH)
), cp_prev_streak_a AS (
  SELECT
    `orders___created_at`,

  FROM base
), cp_reset_streak_a AS (
  SELECT
    `orders___created_at`,
    `orders___amount_sum`,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN NOT `orders___amount_sum` IS NULL
        AND `orders___amount_sum` <> 0
        AND CAST(`_cp_prev_streak_a` AS DATETIME) = DATETIME_ADD(CAST(`orders___created_at` AS DATETIME), INTERVAL -1 MONTH)
        THEN 0
        ELSE 1
      END
    ) OVER (ORDER BY `orders___created_at` ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS `_cp_reset_streak_a`
  FROM cp_prev_streak_a
), cp_value_streak_a AS (
  SELECT
    `orders___created_at`,
    `orders___amount_sum`,
    CASE
      WHEN NOT `orders___amount_sum` IS NULL AND `orders___amount_sum` <> 0
      THEN SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN NOT `orders___amount_sum` IS NULL AND `orders___amount_sum` <> 0
          THEN 1
          ELSE 0
        END
      ) OVER (
        PARTITION BY `_cp_reset_streak_a`
        ORDER BY `orders___created_at`
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
      )

      THEN SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN NOT `orders___amount_sum` IS NULL AND `orders___amount_sum` <> 0
          THEN 1

      ) OVER (
        PARTITION BY `_cp_reset_streak_a`
        ORDER BY `orders___created_at`
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
